page.overview:
Who is Damiano Fulgencio?

Damiano Fulgencio governed the Corrino Imperium as regent for two weeks in 1680 AG, the sixth and last

The previous regent, Maria I Mustami, was forced to resign as the Imperium experienced significant unrest (secretly stimulated by Iraklii Harkonnen). Fulgencio's brief tenure as regent ended in much the same way. In the interregnum that followed Fulgencio's resignation, the only government that existed on an Imperium-wide basis was a loosely organized committee of Houses Major. This lasted until 1701, when a distant imperial descendant, Corrin IV, was proclaimed emperor.
